answer: Each earning key must maintain a separate 10-epoch chain of 60 counterparty-signed deliveries, six per epoch, with partners drawn after commitment. Validators replay five jobs and compare timing/error traces; keys sharing four of five rare faults merge. A voyage may circle an island by one thread, but every extra fake needs 60 fresh paid deliveries, so 1,000 clones require 60,000 jobs. Reused receipts erase rewards; two failed replays slash a 125-credit bond and freeze linked keys for seven epochs.
